purpose: Freeze one directional amount-timing-spread factor, the complete 120-definition semantic library, all 118 eligible numeric comparisons, ordered no-return gates, and exactly one conditional 2019-2023 development trial before opening Campaign089 source rows or values.

candidate.name: intraday_directional_amount_timing_spread_238m
candidate.economic_hypothesis: When transaction amount attached to upward one-minute price changes migrates later in the completed session than amount attached to downward changes, the close reflects a late shift toward buy-side participation that may continue over the next three sessions.
candidate.formula: Form 119 adjacent natural-log close returns separately inside each 120-close half, yielding 238 returns. Associate each return with its destination-bar amount and assign the pooled chronological coordinate u_k=k/237 for k=0,...,237. Let U=sum A_k*1[r_k>0], D=sum A_k*1[r_k<0], T_up=sum u_k*A_k*1[r_k>0]/U, and T_down=sum u_k*A_k*1[r_k<0]/D. Return T_up-T_down.
candidate.source_grid: Require exactly the raw 09:30 row plus all 240 standard bars; select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, form returns only inside each half, and use destination amounts at 09:32-11:30 and 13:02-15:00. The morning-then-afternoon ordinal is only a fixed session-time coordinate and creates no lunch return.
candidate.close_rule: Every selected close must be finite and strictly positive. Use float64 natural logarithms. Exact zero returns remain valid source observations.
candidate.amount_rule: Every destination amount must be finite and nonnegative. Zero amounts remain exact zeros. Amount attached to an exact zero return contributes to neither directional mass.
candidate.support_rule: Require every one of the 238 returns and destination amounts, finite strictly positive U, and finite strictly positive D. Never drop or replace a return or amount and never substitute another grid.
candidate.conditional_normalization_rule: Positive-return and negative-return amount masses are normalized separately before subtracting their clock centers. No relative directional mass level enters the score.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, source-grid mismatch, any invalid selected close or destination amount, missing return support, nonpositive or nonfinite U or D, or a score outside [-1,1] beyond endpoint tolerance. Never impute, smooth, jitter, winsorize, threshold, rank, neutralize, filter, or fit.
